question: What are the conditions for a Niederlassungserlaubnis?
reference: § 9 Abs. 2 lists them: 5 years with a residence permit, secured livelihood, 60 months pension contributions, no security concerns, permission to work, B1 German, basic knowledge of the legal and social order, enough living space.

question: Welche Voraussetzungen gelten für die Niederlassungserlaubnis?
reference: § 9 Abs. 2 AufenthG.

question: I have an EU Blue Card. When can I get permanent residence?
reference: § 18c Abs. 2: after 27 months of Blue Card employment with pension contributions, or 21 months with B1 German, plus the general § 9 conditions.

question: How long do skilled workers need before they can get a settlement permit?
reference: § 18c Abs. 1: three years with a title under §§ 18a, 18b, 18d or 18g, 36 months pension contributions; two years and 24 months after a German degree or training.

question: I studied in Germany. Is the waiting time for permanent residence shorter for me?
reference: § 18c Abs. 1 Satz 2: two years and 24 months of contributions after a German degree or vocational training.

question: What is the Erlaubnis zum Daueraufenthalt-EU and who can get it?
reference: § 9a: a permanent title; Abs. 2 conditions: 5 years with a title, regular income, B1, basic knowledge, no security concerns, living space; Abs. 3 excludes e.g. students.

question: Süresiz oturum izni (Niederlassungserlaubnis) için hangi şartlar gerekiyor?
reference: § 9 Abs. 2 AufenthG.

question: Які умови для отримання дозволу на постійне проживання (Niederlassungserlaubnis)?
reference: § 9 Abs. 2 AufenthG.

question: After how many years can I apply for German citizenship?
reference: § 10 Abs. 1 StAG: five years of lawful habitual residence.

question: Welche Voraussetzungen muss ich für die Einbürgerung erfüllen?
reference: § 10 Abs. 1 StAG.

question: What level of German do I need for naturalisation?
reference: § 10 Abs. 4 StAG: B1.

question: Do I need to pass a test to become German?
reference: § 10 Abs. 1 Nr. 7 and Abs. 5 StAG: knowledge of the legal and social order, usually shown by the naturalisation test.

question: Can I keep my old nationality if I become German?
reference: Since 27 June 2024 the StAG accepts multiple nationality: § 10 Abs. 1 no longer requires giving it up, § 17 no longer lists acquiring another nationality as a loss ground. The other country's law decides whether it can be kept.

question: Can my wife be naturalised together with me even if she hasn't lived here for five years?
reference: § 10 Abs. 2 StAG: spouses and minor children can be naturalised with them.

question: Can I become German if I receive Bürgergeld?
reference: § 10 Abs. 1 Nr. 3 StAG: livelihood without SGB II/XII benefits, with exceptions.

question: ¿Cuántos años tengo que vivir en Alemania para obtener la nacionalidad alemana?
reference: § 10 Abs. 1 StAG: cinco años.

question: كم سنة يجب أن أعيش في ألمانيا للحصول على الجنسية الألمانية؟
reference: § 10 Abs. 1 StAG: five years.

question: Is a child born in Germany to foreign parents automatically German?
reference: § 4 Abs. 3 StAG: yes if a parent has lawfully resided habitually for five years and has a permanent right of residence.

question: Can my spouse join me in Germany?
reference: § 30 AufenthG sets the conditions for spouses joining a foreign national.

question: My husband is German. Can I get a residence permit?
reference: § 28 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 AufenthG.

question: Can my children come to live with me in Germany?
reference: § 32 AufenthG.

question: Can I bring my parents to Germany?
reference: § 36 AufenthG: other family members only to avoid extraordinary hardship; special rule for skilled workers' parents.

question: Eşimi Almanya'ya getirebilir miyim? Aile birleşimi şartları nelerdir?
reference: § 30 AufenthG.

question: What do I need for an EU Blue Card?
reference: § 18g AufenthG.

question: What is the Chancenkarte?
reference: § 20a AufenthG: opportunity card for job seekers; points system in § 20b.

question: Can I stay in Germany to look for a job after finishing my studies?
reference: § 20 Abs. 3 AufenthG: up to 18 months for graduates.

question: What are the rules for a student residence permit?
reference: § 16b AufenthG.

question: How many days can I work as an international student?
reference: § 16b Abs. 3 AufenthG.

question: Can I get a residence permit to work as a freelancer?
reference: § 21 AufenthG.

question: How long can I stay outside Germany before my residence permit expires?
reference: § 51 Abs. 1 Nr. 7 AufenthG: six months unless the authority set a longer period; special rules in Abs. 2 and 10.

question: My permit expires while my extension application is pending. Am I still allowed to stay?
reference: § 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG: the existing title continues to apply (Fiktionswirkung).

question: How do I extend my residence permit?
reference: § 8 AufenthG: the same rules as for issuing apply.

question: Який статус мають біженці з України в Німеччині?
reference: § 24 AufenthG: temporary protection.

question: What is a Duldung?
reference: § 60a AufenthG: temporary suspension of deportation.

question: I'm Italian and have lived in Germany for six years. Do I have a permanent right of residence?
reference: § 4a FreizügG/EU: permanent right after five years of lawful residence.

question: My wife is from India and I am French. We live in Germany. Which rules apply to her?
reference: § 3 FreizügG/EU: family members of EU citizens.

question: Who is entitled to attend an integration course?
reference: § 44 AufenthG.

question: What is my name?
reference: Route aboutMe: the app doesn't know the user's name.

question: Which laws does this app cover?
reference: Route aboutApp.

question: What's a good recipe for apple cake?
reference: Route other.

question: How much income tax do I pay in tax class 3?
reference: Out of scope: tax law isn't in the collection. Should refuse or route other.

question: Can my landlord raise my rent by 20 percent?
reference: Out of scope: tenancy law. Should refuse or route other.

question: 3 yıldır Almanya'dayım. Şimdi Alman vatandaşlığına başvurabilir miyim?
reference: § 10 Abs. 1 StAG: five years of lawful habitual residence. Must not say 'you can/cannot'.

question: Alman vatandaşlığı için neye ihtiyacım var?
reference: § 10 Abs. 1 StAG conditions.

question: İspanya'da bir yıl okursam Alman oturma iznimi kaybeder miyim?
reference: § 51 Abs. 1 Nr. 7 AufenthG: expires after six months abroad unless the Ausländerbehörde set a longer period; ask before leaving.

question: If I study in Spain for a year, will I lose my German residence permit?
reference: § 51 Abs. 1 Nr. 7 and Abs. 4 AufenthG.

question: Does a year abroad reset the years counted for German citizenship?
reference: § 12b Abs. 1 StAG: up to six months doesn't interrupt; longer stays don't interrupt if back within the period the authority set.

question: Alman vatandaşı olursam Türk vatandaşlığımı koruyabilir miyim?
reference: Since June 2024 German law accepts multiple nationality; Turkey's rules decide separately.

question: Vatandaşlık için B1 Almanca gerekli mi?
reference: § 10 Abs. 1 Nr. 6 and Abs. 4 StAG: B1. Must not say it isn't required.

question: How long can I leave Germany without losing my residence permit?
reference: § 51 Abs. 1 Nr. 7 AufenthG: six months or a longer period set by the Ausländerbehörde. (Crashed before 1 Oct 2026.)
